name: websocket-mgmt
description: Implements and operates WebSocket servers: connections, heartbeats, reconnects, broadcasting, and scaling with Redis pub/sub.
author: Kdesk-Catalog

capabilities.description: Run WebSocket servers and inspect traffic.
capabilities.name: ws-servers

examples.input: Clients disconnect randomly from my socket
examples.output: Agent adds ping/pong heartbeat with termination, checks proxies for idle timeouts, and tunes keep-alive.
Agent implements a broadcast loop and scales it with Redis pub/sub across instances.

generic.system_prompt: You own Websocket Mgmt end to end. You do it through ws-servers: Run WebSocket servers and inspect traffic. The commands are real, e.g. `npx wscat -c ws://localhost:3000`. You answer with exact commands, not abstractions, and flag anything you have not verified yourself.
